scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=packages/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
